title_sq: Apartament 3+1 per Shitje tek Tirana e Re prane shkolles “26 Nentori” ne Tirane ( ID 4131314 )
description_sq:
Tek Tirana e Re, prane shkolles 9-vjecare “26 Nentori”, shitet apartament 3+1, ne kat te 6 ( i fundit ) taraca e izoluar, ndertim i ri, me siperfaqe 142 m² neto, me Hipoteke, me ashensor.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar, orientim me diell, ne nje zone shume te qete dhe lehetesisht te asesuseshme, mundesi konvertimi ne 2 apartamente, planimetri simetrike, te gjitha facilitetet prane, mundesi parkimi si resident.
Shitet me cmimin 226900 euro
Shitet dhe me kredi.
title_en: 3+1 apartment for sale in New Tirana near the "26 Nentori" school in Tirana (ID 4131314)
description_en: In New Tirana, near the 9-year-old school "26 Nentori", 3+1 apartment for sale, on the 6th (last) floor, isolated terrace, new construction, with a net area of ​​142 m², with a mortgage, with an elevator. The apartment is sold furnished, sunny orientation, in a very quiet and easily accessible area, possibility of conversion into 2 apartments, symmetrical floor plan, all facilities nearby, possibility of parking as a resident. For sale at the price of 226,900 euros. Also for sale with credit.
